source: Ticket 775 (spec #774), the GD lock of 23 Oct 2026 on Campaign Scaling: the four size classes S/M/L/XL at x0.9/1.0/1.1/1.2 of an SS1 planet's radius at the same time target, on a base of about 25 minutes, so the targets are 22.5/25/27.5/30 (VS and Systems, 23 Oct). Resources go with R squared; price is never retuned per class, and XL is drawn only on standard-surface planets.

economyRows.source: Ticket 776 (spec #774), the Systems rows under the GD lock of 23 Oct 2026 on Campaign Scaling and its VS input. hardnessStepCeiling: the VS's 1.243, the most any planet's ground may step over the planet before at arrival (the system jump's k_jump, kernel economy.json starMap.systemJump.hardnessStep, and the hard start's k_s alike). hardStartStep: k_s, the hard start's step over its system's standard ground; one planet per system, never P1, never stacked with the jump step. Systems recorded only k_jump = 1.10 under the same gate (felt speed about 1/k at least 0.9x after the fee), so k_s takes the same 1.10. feltSpeedFloor: that gate, 0.9x the planet before. poolStepFloor: R3, each planet's ore pool value at least 1.15x the planet before's (#644, #741), gems included. gemShareCapBp: the gem tier at most 15% of a planet's pool value (#741). A gate miss cuts k first, then paceScale, then radius; never a price or the drill law.

materialPool.source: Ticket 777 (spec #774), the generated material pool under the GD lock of 23 Oct 2026 on Campaign Scaling: about 15 kinds per planet (Bjor's ask of 15 Oct on #647), never past the ores slice's 17-kind roster cap (the 8-bit slot). The pool is drawn from the ore mix a planet is generated with at its campaign index, one kind per family and rarity the mix paints, the heaviest split until the target; the gems are the ores slice's three per pool, the rares and gems live only from band 3 (d >= 0.35) in the kernel's 1-3 cell clusters, and the gem share of the pool value stays under the economy rows' gemShareCapBp. Numbers only: no price, hardness or drill law is set here.
materialPool.kindTripCapSource: Ticket 888: the VS's per-kind bounds of a band trip from ticket 446's family-first guard (6226198316), the roster slice's perCommonKindMaxOfBandTrip and perNonCommonKindMax, which a roster test holds these equal to: a run holds at least the kinds its cell's weight and value share of each band ask for under them.
